sub: Punjab foreign medical graduates house jobs on
paragraphs: Punjab Health Department ne bairon-e-mulk se parh kar aane wale doctors ke liye **house job** aur **postgraduate training** ka naya, shaffaf **merit system** banane ka faisla kiya hai.
Iske liye medical universities ke vice-chancellors aur colleges ke principals par mushtamil **9 rukni committee** bana di gayi hai.
Committee degree, registration aur license ki tasdeeq ka tareeqa dekhegi aur applications se placement tak ek **centralised system** tajweez karegi.
Committee ko apni sifarishat **10 din** mein dene ka hukum diya gaya hai.
question: Kya is se doctors ko insaaf milega?
